analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and metadata against the canonical index and selected T-041 detail. No independently supported security regression in this scope. ModelAutopilotPolicy.swift:21–23 bounds holds to one day and requires a load target; existing session/revision, expiry, pin, residency and capacity checks remain. ProviderLoop+AutopilotBusy.swift:13–33 preserves every BASE busy predicate; excluding the owned command matches the previous behavior. ProviderLoop+Autopilot.swift:219–230 adds cancellation checks before successful completion/placement, and :56–82,279 gates new operational telemetry and status detail on consent. These changes do not visibly alter encryption, attestation, billing or cache isolation (A-001/A-003, T-008, T-041, T-052/T-053).
Security-relevant expansion remains for integration: AutopilotStartInventory.swift:38–87 admits verified unselected cached builds, using catalog hashes or offline ledger equality, while ProviderLoop+Autopilot.swift:50 makes the effective set the command-policy selection. ModelAutopilotSettings.swift:3–7 describes downloads under saved consent, but :31–36 retains the existing consent representation. Verify consent migration/UX and download enablement in the other PR units before concluding whether old residency-only permission is widened. Also trace catalog/ledger hash provenance, actual hashing and background candidate promotion against A-004, T-012/T-027 and T-041's verified model binding; local ledger equality alone is not coordinator authorization.
Review placement/hold enforcement, atomic state publication and watchdog ownership/recovery through recordAutopilotPlacement, reconcileAutopilotPlacements and state.publishModelAutopilot. ProviderLoop+AutopilotControl.swift has metadata and a bounded orientation patch only; its effective-set admission and refresh/revocation interactions need reconciliation with full source. These missing contracts are coverage limits, not findings.
